related_routes.boq_scan_review: /crm/boqs/{boq}/scans/{scan}/review (BoqScanController@review) -- reachable as of 2026-08-28 (see boq_scan_ocr_flow.review_page below for its history of intermittently 404ing)

pages.note: Confirmed live against the real demo 2026-08-28 while building capture/specs/boq_scan_to_quote.spec.ts. Real selectors/fields captured here so future sessions don't have to re-derive them.

setup_prerequisites.company: POST /crm/companies -- required field: name. Reused across runs by searching GET /crm/companies?search=<name> and matching an exact-text <a> in the results.
setup_prerequisites.deal: POST /crm/deals -- required fields: company_id (select), title, pipeline_id (select, id=dealPipelineSelect), stage_id (select, id=dealStageIdSelect). Check #dealBoqEnabledInput so the deal supports a BOQ. Submit button text 'Save Deal'.
setup_prerequisites.boq: POST /crm/boqs -- required fields: company_id (select), opportunity_id (select, client-side filtered by company_id -- wait ~500ms after selecting company before the opportunity list updates), title. Submit button text 'Save Draft'. Must stay in status draft/in_progress/rejected with opportunity_id set for the scan route to be reachable (BoqScanController::authorizeScan).

scan_page.gating: 422 'boq_scan_requires_deal' if opportunity_id is null; 422 'boq_not_editable_for_scan' if status isn't draft/in_progress/rejected or the user lacks crm.boq.edit; requires feature flag site_visit_document_ocr enabled + permission crm.site_visit.document.ocr (both true on this tenant as of 2026-08-28).
scan_page.file_inputs: #boqScanTakePhotoInput (accept image/*), #boqScanUploadImageInput (accept image/jpeg,png,webp,heic,heif), #boqScanUploadPdfInput (accept application/pdf) -- all class=d-none, set via setInputFiles() directly rather than clicking the visible button (clicking triggers a native OS file dialog)
scan_page.unfinished_scan_state: If a scan is already in progress/unreviewed for this BOQ, the page instead shows a 'Unfinished BOQ scan' panel with a 'Resume Review' link (href to the review route below), '#boqScanDiscard' button (data-discard-url to PUT/DELETE .../scans/{scan}), and '#boqScanStartNew' button. A fresh BOQ per capture attempt avoids this state.

review_page.status_history: Found completely unreachable 2026-08-28 09:05-09:11 UTC: returned Laravel's default 404 with NO route registered at all (17 consecutive polls over 105s, all NotFoundHttpException). GET on the sibling /crm/boqs/{boq}/scans/{scan} (no /review) returned 405 with Allow: PUT, DELETE -- so the update/discard routes existed but no GET/show route did. Re-tested ~20 minutes later (09:38 UTC) inside the actual capture-spec run and returned 200 both times reached. This tenant is evidently an actively-deployed staging environment (also saw intermittent /login and /crm/boqs/{id} 500s the same session) -- treat 'unreachable' findings here as time-stamped, not permanent.
review_page.confirmed_working_2026-08-28: capture/specs/boq_scan_to_quote.spec.ts ran end to end through this route successfully (library/ui/boq_scan_to_quote/2026-08-28.mp4).
review_page.not_yet_known: Real selectors for the line-item review/edit UI, the confirm/import action, and the resulting quotation route (QuotationController@fromBoq) -- the capture spec currently only asserts the review page loads (HTTP 200), it doesn't yet film or assert on what's inside it.
